beaches.name: Playa Chihuahua
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is permitted on a delimited stretch of Playa Chihuahua. The Intendencia de Maldonado's Digesto Departamental (arts. R.104-R.106, from Res. 7823/2012) permits naturist practice between Arroyo El Potrero (west), the southward projection of the main avenue (east) and the dune line (north), and orders informational signage of the limits. A later Resolución 08839/2012, available only as a copy on a hotel website, moves the eastern limit to calle El Foque; the Digesto does not reflect it.
